_help: Act 2, the labour market: hiring Mahmoud Fawzi's experienced excavators (hired_mahmoud), 60, or 75 if you keep the credit. Fatima el-Sayed, the broker, introduces the first crew you visit (met_fatima). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

fatima.speaker: fatima
fatima.line: I am Fatima el-Sayed. I place good workers with good employers, and I remember which employers were not. Mahmoud Fawzi's men are the best excavators in Cairo, and they know it.

already.speaker: mahmoud
already.line: My men are ready. Picks sharpened, baskets mended.

first.speaker: mahmoud
first.line: My men have dug for the British, the French and the Americans. Every one of them took the credit. What will you take?

choices.label: Their finds are their own
choices.line: Whatever your men find, the record says who found it.

choices.label: I pay, I take the credit
choices.line: I pay the wages. The credit's mine.

fee.speaker: mahmoud
fee.line: Then sixty pounds, for twelve men and their tools.

fee_cold.speaker: mahmoud
fee_cold.line: Then you pay for the credit as well. Seventy-five.

joined.speaker: mahmoud
joined.line: Good. We dig carefully, and we dig well.
